adoption_current_state.quote: Adoption is growing, but it is still concentrated in larger academic hospitals and private centres with stronger capital budgets.

capital_budget_barrier.quote: The biggest issue is still capital budget approval.

roi_driver.quote: Very important. The clinical argument may get surgeons interested, but the finance team wants to understand utilisation, procedure volume, maintenance cost and whether the system will actually pay for itself.

training_importance.quote: Training matters, especially in the first year.

clinical_outcomes_position.quote: Clinical outcomes are necessary, but they are not enough on their own.

adoption_outlook.quote: I expect adoption to continue increasing, probably steadily rather than explosively.

purchase_timeline.quote: Six to twelve months is realistic once the hospital becomes serious.

tco_focus.quote: We look at total cost of ownership, expected procedure volume, maintenance, service contracts and training requirements.

training_barrier.quote: Funding is important, but I would say training capacity is just as important.
